name: askone
description: Read your AskOne live Q&A rooms, audience questions and poll results, and draft a FAQ from them.
long_description: AskOne is live Q&A and polling for talks, webinars, classes and meetings. This extension gives Claude read-only access to your organization's rooms: list them, read a room's questions as a Markdown FAQ draft (answered first, approved by votes, pending last), read raw question pages, and read aggregate poll, quiz, rating and word-cloud results. It cannot create, moderate or delete anything. An organization admin creates the API token in AskOne: organization switcher, Manage, API tokens.

tools.name: list_rooms
tools.description: List your organization's rooms, newest first, with question and participant counts.

tools.name: get_room_qa
tools.description: Read a room's questions as a Markdown FAQ draft.

tools.name: get_room_questions
tools.description: Read one page of a room's questions as JSON.

tools.name: get_survey_results
tools.description: Read aggregate poll, quiz, rating and word-cloud results.

api_token.title: AskOne API token
api_token.description: Created by an organization admin in AskOne: organization switcher → Manage → API tokens.

base_url.title: AskOne URL
base_url.description: Change only for a self-hosted installation.
